nodes.label: Points Compare-Split Workbench
nodes.rationale: A true 50/50 Compare-split workbench built in the Points topic's own standalone architecture (DOM re-parenting of driver controls into a docked rail + a body.compare-split CSS grid), NOT via the shared engine's initSim keys, because Points was migrated off engine.js (ADR-033). Single-WebGL-canvas invariant preserved.

nodes.label: 3D-to-2D Orthographic Fold Swoop
nodes.rationale: The fold now SWOOPS square-on to the orthographic answer sheet (ADR-036), overturning ADR-013's held-angle hold; the held-angle movers (animateFoldHold/framePerspectiveToFlat) are deleted and preFoldPose is no longer stored since the perspective camera never moves during the swoop.

nodes.label: Lines 2D Compare Sheet-Locked Scale
nodes.rationale: The 2D Compare drawing is a fixed sheet-locked scale (SHEET2D_SPAN derived from SHEET = (SHEET/2)*10 = 300mm per half), never auto-zooming, so a real mm reads the same on-screen length at any True Length and the worst-case line never overflows the sheet.

nodes.label: System-Wide Ortho Orbit Lock
nodes.rationale: enableRotate=false on every dual-camera ortho OrbitControls pair, with a qv-lock-cue shake+ring nudge on the latched quick-view chip when a left-drag is attempted in a locked ortho view.

nodes.label: Quiet Chrome Scrollbar Harmonization
nodes.rationale: ADR-032 system-wide scrollbar harmonization: WebKit thumb + Firefox scrollbar-color retinted to --color-border everywhere, replacing accent-blue tints and hidden scrollbars, so learners get a 'more content below' cue in the Quiet-Chrome style (hiding a scrollbar fails Visibility of System Status).

nodes.label: Clinical Palette Reversal
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 palette inverted paper/panel tones (--color-paper #ffffff, --color-panel #f5f5f5) across all 7 shells so the viewport is white and panels are gray; retires the warm-paper 'deliberately not clinical' framing for the web team's clinical palette. WCAG contrast re-measurement flagged mandatory.

nodes.label: Quadrant Numeral Occlusion
nodes.rationale: Quadrant numerals I-IV now occlude behind the HP/VP sheets via a per-frame updateOcclusion() raycast from the live camera, since CSS2D labels bypass the depth buffer; also moved to far outer corners so they never overlap point P or projectors.

nodes.label: Spatial Framework Topic
nodes.rationale: Quadrants + First-angle combined into one Module-1 topic built on the Module 2 orchestrator pattern (ADR-033): a 5-step 'Room & Shadow' guided stepper reusing the platform's cinematic fold animation, with Point P distances clamped 1-40cm to enforce quadrant pedagogy.

nodes.label: Foundations Topic (Bearing Block)
nodes.rationale: An orbitable 3D bearing block teaching the four BIS line types with a live line-of-sight (raycast) hidden-line classifier, built on the Module 2 orchestrator pattern and retaining meshAnalyzer.js (ADR-029 supersedes ADR-011 for this topic only).

nodes.label: three-mesh-bvh Occlusion Acceleration
nodes.rationale: Integrated three-mesh-bvh through the CDN import map to accelerate the non-convex occlusion raycaster (ADR-030), and replaced the ~100ms debounce with rAF throttling dirty-gated on camera movement (ADR-031) so hidden lines update live as the part orbits, preserving the no-build contract.

nodes.label: PLATFORM-RULES.md Extraction
nodes.rationale: Extracted the subject-agnostic subset of RULES.md (platform contract, UI & Visual, generic Cross-Subject Harmony, Documentation) so a new engineering-discipline module has a ready checklist without Engineering-Graphics-specific rules.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.module-template.md
nodes.rationale: A starter CLAUDE.md for a brand-new Simatrix subject module carrying only the platform-wide contract, with an explicit instruction that a new subject must author its own ARCHITECTURE/DECISIONS/RULES docs before writing simulation code.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md Centralization
nodes.rationale: One consolidated code-audited platform design system merged from four former per-module DESIGN.md / DESIGN.shared.md copies (ADR-022 supersedes ADR-010), so the visual contract has a single source of truth instead of four drifting copies.

nodes.label: PRODUCT.md Centralization
nodes.rationale: One consolidated code-audited platform product contract merged from two former byte-identical per-module PRODUCT.md files (ADR-023, parallels ADR-022) so persona/anti-references/principles/accessibility commitments have a single source of truth.

nodes.label: Root Enforcement Docs (RULES/DECISIONS/ARCHITECTURE)
nodes.rationale: RULES.md (120 DO/NEVER enforcement rules), DECISIONS.md (ADR log recording WHY key choices were made), and ARCHITECTURE.md (whole-repo architecture map) established so every documented decision is actionable and future contributors don't accidentally undo reversed decisions.

nodes.label: MODULE-STARTER.md Playbook
nodes.rationale: A from-scratch code-verified playbook for creating a new sim (new Module 2 topic, new Module 1 lesson, or new subject module), with byte-identical file lists confirmed by md5sum and a pre-ship verification checklist citing its RULES/ADR/DESIGN sources.
